name: folio
description: Make, edit, check and export books in Folio, the local-first book layout app.
long_description: Lets Claude make a book, bring a manuscript in, change its pages, look at them, run preflight and export a PDF or EPUB. If Folio is open, Claude works on the book you have open and you can undo what it does.
